'''Den Sait Glass''' was a member of the [[Renatasian Confederation]], a vigilante organization made up of natives of the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]], looking to avenge the conquest of their home by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Glass served in a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] traveled to the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] in search of [[Vuffi Raa]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] the Confederation believed sold out Renatasia to the Empire. In the ensuing fight with Raa's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', Glass and almost the entire remaining squadron was [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving leader [[Klyn Shanga]] the only survivor.<ref name="oseon" />
